changeSet.sql: INSERT IGNORE INTO condition_operands (operand, operand_data_type, operand_type, operand_subject, project_id, is_deleted) SELECT DISTINCT left(rso.operand, 55), left(rso.operand_type, 10), 'LITERAL', 'RESOURCE_SET', p.project_id, 0 FROM resource_sets rs LEFT JOIN resource_set_conditions rsc ON rs.id = rsc.resource_set_id LEFT JOIN resource_set_operands rso ON rso.resource_set_condition_id = rsc.id LEFT JOIN projects p ON rs.project_id = p.project_id WHERE rso.operand IS NOT NULL AND rso.operand_type IS NOT NULL;

changeSet.author: [Z4999972] Aditya Murda
changeSet.sql: UPDATE resource_set_operands r INNER JOIN resource_set_conditions rsc ON r.resource_set_condition_id = rsc.id INNER JOIN resource_sets rs ON rsc.resource_set_id = rs.id INNER JOIN condition_operands t ON r.operand = t.operand AND r.operand_type = t.operand_data_type AND t.operand_subject = 'RESOURCE_SET' AND t.project_id = rs.project_id SET r.operand_id = t.id;
